name: COMPETITION
description: Pointer to the competition database record (TComp), the Comp base field (as league::COMPETITION)
evidence: every cup constructor stores its record argument at +4 (AsiaSuperCup/InterAmerCup/UsaMlsAllStars/ConChamp/WorldClubCup/AsiaClubChamp/AsiaCupWinner ctors); league::COMPETITION is the same Comp base offset

name: COMP_STATS
description: Pointer to the competition's Comp_Stats object, 0 = none; the Comp base field (as league::COMP_STATS)
evidence: the cup constructors store Comp_Stats::Comp_Stats(new 0x5ce, this) (0x49ee70) at +8 and show the error box when it is null; start_new_cup_season archives +8 with Comp_Stats::archive_season_and_reset

name: UPPER_DIVISION_ID
description: Competition id of the division above, -1 = none; the Comp base field (as league::UPPER_DIVISION_ID)
evidence: AsiaClubChamp::AsiaClubChamp (0x40aae0) and AsiaCupWinner::AsiaCupWinner (0x40cbe0) write -1 at +0x1c, as the League constructors do at league::UPPER_DIVISION_ID

name: LOWER_DIVISION_ID
description: Competition id of the division below, -1 = none; the Comp base field (as league::LOWER_DIVISION_ID)
evidence: AsiaClubChamp::AsiaClubChamp (0x40aae0) and AsiaCupWinner::AsiaCupWinner (0x40cbe0) write -1 at +0x20, as the League constructors do at league::LOWER_DIVISION_ID
